recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
wget -q -O /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -- https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.20.0/node-v22.20.0-linux-x64.tar.xz
sha256sum -c <<< '00bbd05e306ea68b6e13e17360d0e2f680b493ef95f2fea1c4296ff7437530bc  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v22.20.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
npm install --global corepack@latest
corepack enable pnpm
corepack use pnpm@latest-9
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm cap sync
pushd android
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew clean assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
